li.label: Poor Adorning Ceremony
li.description: I was given a trophy, but the ceremony was underwhelming. Barely anyone showed up.

li.label: Adorned with a Trophy
li.description: I was recognized for my bravery. It was a decent ceremony.

li.label: Grand Adorning Ceremony
li.description: I was recognized for my service before the whole tribe. It is an honor to wear this trophy.

li.label: Legendary Adorning Ceremony
li.description: The entire tribe gathered to honor me. I will never forget this moment.

li.label: Witnessed an Adorning Ceremony
li.description: I watched one of our own be honored for their service. It was moving.
